title: Introducing BPA-equivalents: assessing mixture toxicity and substitution of BPA in environmental exposure scenarios
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2026, Advance Article

Vanessa Srebny, Georg Braun, Niklas Wojtysiak, Beate. I. Escher
Mixtures of bisphenol A and five analogs showed concentration-additive effects at ratios found in European surface waters: BPS and BPB were most abundant, while BPB and BPAF drove cytotoxicity and estrogenic effects.
